title: Habitual resentment turns neutral people into perceived adversaries, until the social world seems full of enemies
body:
- The habit of forming resentments reframes neutral interactions as hostile acts.
- Each new resentment converts the target from a neutral party into a perceived adversary.
- Accumulated over time, this process populates the person's social world with perceived threats.
conversion: Neutral people become perceived adversaries, and the social world comes to appear full of enemies.
